Your farm's paperwork.
Finally usable.
hero.body: Invoices, delivery notes, labels, farm records, handwritten notes: upload them to Seminai. It extracts the data, organizes it and makes it ready for whatever you need: a question in chat, an Excel report, the field logbook.
ticker: Invoices, delivery notes, labels, records, handwritten notes

problem.title: The data is already there. It's just scattered.
problem.lead: Every day your farm produces valuable information. But it sits in WhatsApp, in email, in drawers, in PDFs nobody opens again.

cards.title: Scattered.
cards.body: Supplier invoices, delivery notes in the warehouse, operator notes, farm records at the co-op. One piece in each place.

cards.title: Locked.
cards.body: You can't query a PDF or a photo. To know what you spent or how much product is left, you have to reread everything.

cards.title: Retyped.
cards.body: Hours copying the same data for the accountant, the advisor, the certifier, the inspections.

problem.bridge: Seminai collects it, reads it and puts it in order. Just once.

solution.title: How it works: upload, extract, use.
solution.lead: Three steps. The first takes thirty seconds.

steps.label: Upload
steps.heading: Upload any document.
steps.body: Photos, PDFs, emails, scans. Invoices, delivery notes, labels, farm records, handwritten notes. Messy is fine, from any source.

steps.label: Extract
steps.heading: Seminai extracts and organizes.
steps.body: Products, quantities, lots, suppliers, dates, plots. Every value linked to the others and to its source document.

steps.label: Use
steps.heading: Use the data for whatever you need.
steps.body: Ask in chat, download as PDF or Excel, fill in the field logbook. Your data works for you.

capabilities.title: One place for your data. Endless ways to use it.
capabilities.lead: Once extracted, the data is yours: query it, export it, reuse it.

items.title: Ask in chat.
items.body: “How much copper did I apply to the north vineyard this year?” The answer comes back in seconds, with the source document.

items.title: Download as PDF and Excel.
items.body: Reports ready for your accountant, bank, certifier or management software.

items.title: Fill in the field logbook.
items.body: Treatments go in automatically, with doses checked against the label.

items.title: Keep stock and records aligned.
items.body: Every invoice and delivery note updates your inventory.

trust.title: And the field logbook fills itself in.
trust.lead: From your uploaded documents Seminai prepares the logbook and checks every treatment against official sources. If something is off, it flags it with the source and the fix.
trust.foot: You review. You approve. You sign. Responsibility stays where it belongs.

items.question: What documents can I upload?
items.answer: Invoices, delivery notes, labels, farm records and handwritten notes. As photos, PDFs, scans or forwarded emails. No need to sort them first.

items.question: What can I do with the extracted data?
items.answer: Query it in chat, download it as PDF or Excel, fill in the field logbook and keep inventory and records up to date. Every value links back to the document it came from.

items.question: Do I need to change how I work?
items.answer: No. You keep receiving documents as you do today and upload them to Seminai. If you already use management software, Seminai integrates through APIs.

items.question: Is the field logbook compliant? Who signs it?
items.answer: Seminai checks every treatment against the ministerial label, production protocols, European regulation and regional bulletins, and flags anomalies with the source. You review, approve and sign the logbook.

items.question: Is my data safe?
items.answer: It is encrypted in transit and at rest, on European servers. It is not shared with third parties or used to train AI models. You can export or delete it anytime.

items.question: Does Seminai read a delivery note?
items.answer: Yes. Open the document and Seminai fills in supplier, item and quantity. You check the fields before they are saved.

items.question: How do I accept a warehouse load?
items.answer: When the document looks right, click Accept load. On-hand stock increases by the quantity read from the delivery note.

items.question: Can chat change the records?
items.answer: Yes. Write what you want to change, for example moving pieces from one warehouse to another. Seminai updates the stock and shows you the result.

items.question: Is moving my data in free?
items.answer: Moving the data you already have (documents, master data, stock) is free for the first 200 users. The counter on the page starts at 143 and then follows verified accounts past that number, up to 200.
